344 County Road 4744
Kempner, TX 76539
$325,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,551 SF, MLS# 548816

Come home to this lovely property in the country. Accented by a white fence, this home really stands out! This 3BR/2BA home has a huge Family room with a wood burning fireplace.   The master bathroom has a walk in shower, and a vanity with two sinks. The master suite is on the opposite side of the home away from the minor bedrooms. The kitchen and dining room are open to the family room. The original patio was remodeled to house a home office, and a deck was added to the back of the home. The outbuilding is designed for car maintenance and storage, and makes a great man cave. (The car lift will be removed prior to closing.) This home is within Lampasas ISD, and will qualify for bus service. Call to see this beautiful home today!

2 full bath
